changes.to: PROGRESS (7e485fb): TTFA median 228->166ms, RTF 0.29->0.25, worst-voice 280->192ms. Root cause found: entire prefill forward + KV cache ran in Float32 — add_tensors_as_rounded_bf16_values did a host round-trip and stored fp32; fp32 bias cast on quantized text_projection promoted embed_text; fp32 speaker x-vector promoted the prompt concat. Fixed: on-device bf16 adds, dtype-preserving bias load for quantized layers, authoritative bf16 cast at generate_codes_streaming entry, explicit SdpaMask routing (causal mode for prefill; array-mode reroute alone made no measurable difference). REMAINING vs python (120ms/0.22): ~46ms median. Prefill still ~105ms@290pos (0.36ms/pos). Candidates: (1) code predictor = 15 sequential 5-layer steps/frame, launch-bound — python likely benefits from mx.compile'd step; check mlx-c compile API; (2) predict_code_0 sampling path (host round-trips?); (3) vocoder first-chunk cost; (4) MLX qmm dispatch for M~300 prefill vs dequant+gemm crossover. NOTE: dtype changes shift sampling rounding — outputs differ slightly from previous wavs; needs a quality spot-check (new wavs in foxline benchmarks/tts-ab/rust-mlx).

note: Fade-in verified by listening (2026-07-08): quality still very good post-fix. Python worker mirror fix tracked in foxline fxl-r8qn.7.
